subject: Cannot overlay raster with telemetry object

messages.author: 2e560ed314f372da
messages.subject: Cannot overlay raster with telemetry object
parts:
Hi, 

I'm pretty new to the ctmm package and I'm having some troubles concerning the overlay between a raster file (uploaded with the raster package) and a telemetry object.

Both of them are in WGS84 long/lat (EPSG: 4326), but when I try to plot them, it is not possible to me to see them on the same map. This give me problems when I try to run further analyses wit the rsf.fit() function.

My dataset looks like:
head(data)
 ID                         timestamp              longitude    latitude
Alberto_post 2020-02-29 20:00:00  13.22506 46.38657
Alberto_post 2020-03-01 15:00:00  13.22677 46.37887
Alberto_post 2020-03-02 10:01:00  13.23709 46.37619
Alberto_post 2020-03-03 05:01:00  13.25455 46.34625
Alberto_post 2020-03-04 00:01:00  13.24134 46.38503
Alberto_post 2020-03-04 19:01:00  13.24211 46.38596

And my script:
animal<-as.telemetry(data)
layer<-raster("layer.tif")
ctmm::plot(alby_post,R=layer) #here appears only the telemetry object
#Or if I try this way, the raster is plotted but not the points
plot(layer)
points(animal$longitude~animal$latitude)

Animal #just to see the projecion

$projection
[1] "+proj=tpeqd +lat_1=46.3788607006259 +lon_1=13.2298958522174 +lat_2=46.366020709873 +lon_2=13.2868493138661 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

layer #just to see the crs

class      : RasterLayer
dimensions : 288, 467, 134496  (nrow, ncol, ncell)
resolution : 3e-04, 3e-04  (x, y)
extent     : 13.18886, 13.32896, 46.32505, 46.41145  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
crs        : +proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs
source     : layer.tif
names      : layer

I think it's the same crs, isn't it?
However, if I try to impose the crs to the telemetry object it returns an error

wgs<-CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
animal<-as.telemetry(data,projection=wgs)
Error in validate.projection(proj) :
A projected coordinate syetm must be specified.

I'm pretty sure I'm doing something wrong, but I cannot figure out it.

Thanks in advance
Lorenzo

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Cannot overlay raster with telemetry object
parts:
Hi Lorenzo,

With the data that you sent me, the summary() of the tracking data shows:

$`longitude range` [1] 13.21300 13.29266
$`latitude range` [1] 46.34345 46.39001

but the summary of the TIF file shows:

extent : 13.02221, 13.07831, 46.1996, 46.2497 (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)

so the extents of the tracking data and raster do not overlap. The raster is south-west of the tracking data. You have to zoom way out to see both. By default, the ctmm::plot() function focuses on the data, but you can set the extent as you want.



Also, if you want to do RSFs, then you will want to use an extent of spatial data much larger than the extent of the tracking data, so that the available area can be properly fit.

Best,
Chris
